name: research-results-v1
authority: Deterministic structure, identity, integrity, freshness arithmetic, supersession, append-only history, exception binding, and constraint satisfaction. It does not determine truth, credibility, semantic support, source independence, argument quality, or editorial risk acceptance.

artifact.immutability: Existing result projections are immutable. Candidate aggregates may append results but may not delete or mutate historical results.

rules: same normalized evaluated text retains claim revision
changed normalized evaluated text requires higher claim revision and a new result
new evidence for unchanged text retains claim revision but increases result revision
semantic equivalence and materially different propositions are not inferred deterministically

authorization.validation_ok: All structure and integrity rules pass; STALE may remain auditable and validation_ok.
authorization.authorization_ok: Exactly one VALID current head exists for each claim and its recommendation/disagreement/temporal state permits ordinary use.
authorization.ok_alias: Aliases authorization_ok, never mere parse or structural success.

rules: qualification_required=true requires at least one unique constraint
future Story satisfaction uses exact constraint IDs and exact result digest only

google_doc_rules: source_ref must equal stable container source_id
source.unknown_origin: Legal with original_source=null and a non-authoritative source class, normally UNKNOWN; never fabricate original metadata.

independence.rule: Research supplies independence_group and independence_basis. Different URLs or containers do not prove independence.
independence.derived: independent_support_count is unique independence_group count across SUPPORTS evidence with resolved sources.

temporal.current: Requires as_of and MAX_AGE_DAYS or REVIEW_BY policy; supporting sources require retrieved_at.
temporal.historical: Requires effective_date; age alone never expires it.
temporal.evergreen: No arbitrary age expiry; supplied content/fingerprint drift may stale it.
temporal.unclassified: May validate as incomplete work but cannot authorize downstream use.

offline_observation: current_sources may supply accessible, retrieved_content_sha256, source_fingerprint_sha256, and container_content_sha256. Validator performs no network access.

digest.algorithm: SHA-256 of compact UTF-8 JSON after recursive object-key sort and deterministic ordering of alias_ids, sources, evidence, wording_constraints, provenance_inputs, and unresolved_questions.
digest.property: Semantic authoritative mutations change the digest; aggregate ordering and unrelated appended results do not.

supersession: result_revision positive and strictly greater than superseded result
one VALID unsuperseded head per claim
append_only_api: validateAppendOnly(previousAggregate, candidateAggregate) compares canonical historical result projections and validates the candidate.

human_exception.approval_projection: Canonical exception bytes excluding approval_binding, preventing recursive self-hashing.
human_exception.rule: Exception authorizes only an exact supplied use, does not mutate Research judgment, and cannot repair invalid evidence. No approval is recorded by Phase A.
